source_ref.description: An existing persistent record ID. In a reasoning commit only, @name refers to an earlier successfully processed row declared with alias name in this same commit. Ordinary tool calls require existing persistent IDs.

anyOf.description: Select the complete reported repetition numeral, which may be decimal digits or an English cardinal word expression. Outer witness offsets are UTF8 bytes; number_start and number_end are Unicode character positions inside that exact quote. Do not supply a converted number. Qualified or unsupported counts retain partial source information; repetition meaning is selected separately.
